control_requirements: Every table cell indexed by ordered row, column and signed output; preserve distinction between ordinary and split carrier.
A flipped sign or swapped operand in O/O' must be independently detected.
Scalar signature and source Clifford '±' remain scoped to source cases rather than imported conventions.
No implicit associativity of octonions; preserve source right-multiplication-before-left-multiplication order.
Preserve gamma_cd antisymmetry as source claim without assuming general commutator Lie laws.
Continue source audit across remaining L05 and L01–L06 before any 191-item SSC-completeness claim.
